documents.title: WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
documents.why: The reference doses (minutes per week, intensity, muscle-strengthening days, balance for older adults, limits on sitting) for every age group, pregnancy/postpartum and adults with chronic conditions such as hypertension.

documents.title: No Time to Lift? Designing Time-Efficient Training Programs for Strength and Hypertrophy: A Narrative Review
documents.why: Concrete resistance-training prescriptions for untrained people (weekly sets per muscle, load and rep ranges, frequency, rest, exercise choice) and how to build short, effective sessions.

documents.title: Revisiting the 'Whys' and 'Hows' of the Warm-Up: Are We Asking the Right Questions?
documents.why: What a warm-up is for (performance, injury risk, readiness), how to build one, and how to keep it from turning into fatigue.

documents.title: International Exercise Recommendations in Older Adults (ICFSR): Expert Consensus Guidelines
documents.journal: The Journal of Nutrition, Health & Aging
documents.why: Expert consensus prescription for people over 65: resistance, aerobic, balance and flexibility doses, multicomponent programs, falls prevention and progression for frail or deconditioned adults.

documents.title: Efficacy and potential determinants of exercise therapy in knee and hip osteoarthritis: A systematic review and meta-analysis
documents.journal: Annals of Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine
documents.why: How much exercise therapy improves pain, function and quality of life in knee/hip osteoarthritis, how the benefit evolves (peak around 8 weeks, fading after 9 months) and who benefits most.

documents.title: Development and validation of the physical exercise program "Active Mums" for postpartum recovery: application of the CReDECI-2 guidelines
documents.why: A postpartum exercise program built from international recommendations: session structure, periodization from early to late postpartum, pelvic floor training, screening and fitness tests.

documents.title: Exercise for Hypertension: A Prescription Update Integrating Existing Recommendations with Emerging Research
documents.why: An updated FITT prescription (frequency, intensity, time, type) for adults with hypertension, combining aerobic and dynamic resistance training, with the expected blood-pressure reductions.

documents.title: Non-occupational physical activity and risk of cardiovascular disease, cancer and mortality outcomes: a dose-response meta-analysis of large prospective studies
documents.why: How much risk drops with small amounts of activity (e.g. half the recommended minimum), so a sedentary beginner can be given a realistic first target.

documents.title: Counteracting Physical Inactivity during the COVID-19 Pandemic: Evidence-Based Recommendations for Home-Based Exercise
documents.journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
documents.why: Training at home with little space and no equipment: bodyweight strength work, short high-intensity intervals, breaking up sitting time, and the safety checks (contraindications, supervision for novices) before starting.

documents.title: Key Factors Associated with Adherence to Physical Exercise in Patients with Chronic Diseases and Older Adults: An Umbrella Review
documents.journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
documents.why: The factors that make people stick with an exercise program (supervision, social support, goal setting, enjoyment, feedback) to make a plan sustainable.
